explanation: Dahl drew on his schooldays at Repton, where the chocolate maker Cadbury sent boxes of new bars for pupils to taste and rate.

claims.text: In Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, the Oompa-Loompas work in Willy Wonka's factory.
The Munchkins (from Oz), the Borrowers (Mary Norton's books) and the Gremlins do not work in Wonka's factory.
When Roald Dahl was a pupil at Repton School, Cadbury sent boxes of new chocolates for the boys to test and rate, as he recalled in his memoir Boy.
Dahl linked the Repton chocolate tests to the idea for Charlie and the Chocolate Factory.

evidence.restatement: In his memoir Boy, Dahl recalls Cadbury sending Repton boys boxes of new chocolate bars to test and mark.
